text.tspan: Deaths from famines by main cause and yearWorld
Deaths from famines that are estimated to have killed 100,000 people or more. The World Peace Foundation
classifies them by four main causes ("triggers") - adverse climate, government policies, armed conflict, or
genocide - to summarize the established view among scholars.
